All — I've sketched owners and a concrete escape-hatch sequence below. Happy to adjust but let's lock this in by EOD Thu.

Cutover & rollback owner assignments (proposal):
- Cutover Lead: Ben Carter (redwood) — overall orchestration and final go/no-go.
- Rollback Lead: Rafael Mendes (redwood) — trigger rollback, coordinate fallback capacity.
- Prod Validation Lead: Aditya Rao (redwood) — run validation checklist and post-cutover acceptance.
- DB Migration Monitor: Laura Bennett (redwood) — watch migration progress and metrics.
- Orchid Point of Contact: Rajesh Kumar — final sign-off and traffic ramp approval.

Escape-hatch sequence (short):
1) If 5xx rate > 1% for 3 consecutive 1-min windows => Rollback Lead notified; cut traffic to fallback model variant.
2) If latency 95p > 3s sustained for 10 minutes => consider partial rollback and increase capacity.
3) If data integrity or migration failure detected => immediate full rollback and DB restore plan (owned by Rafael & Laura).

Cutover window confirmation: 02:00–04:00 UTC on May 20 — Rafael to confirm infra reservation by May 8.

Attachments referenced: [cutover-window-owners.csv]
